title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees Eligibility Figures: No Pass, No Play Periods and the Transfer Varsity Wait
content:
Each activity type of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** names the academic rule that governs it, the grading period checked, the days of grace and the minimum period of ineligibility, and the varsity wait for a transfer student.

| Activity type | Academic rule | Grading period used | Days after the grading period ends before a failing grade makes the student ineligible | Minimum school weeks of ineligibility before a progress check can restore eligibility | Varsity wait after a transfer without a bona fide residence move (days from the first day of attendance at the new campus) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campus Club Membership | none | not applicable | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| UIL Academic and Robotics Team | UIL no pass, no play | nine-week grading period | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| Middle School UIL Athletics | UIL no pass, no play | nine-week grading period | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| Fine Arts Performing Ensemble | UIL no pass, no play | nine-week grading period | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| High School UIL Athletics | UIL no pass, no play | nine-week grading period | 7 | 3 | 365 |
| Cheer and Dance Team | UIL no pass, no play | nine-week grading period | 7 | 3 | 0 |
| Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip | none | not applicable | 7 | 3 | 0 |

Days are calendar days. A varsity wait of 0 means the type has no transfer wait.

## Points of reading

- The grace and minimum-period figures bite only where the academic rule is UIL no pass, no play; Campus Club Membership and the Grade 5 Outdoor Education Trip carry the figures but have no academic rule.
- The 365-day varsity wait belongs to High School UIL Athletics alone. It is counted in calendar days from the first day of attendance at the new campus.
